description: This file defines a custom exception class named ProvisioningCategoryCannotBeDeletedException, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException. It is part of the provisioning exception handling in the Fineract platform, specifically related to provisioning categories that cannot be deleted.

classes.name: ProvisioningCategoryCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a provisioning category cannot be deleted. It extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and provides a constructor to pass in message codes and arguments.

methods.name: ProvisioningCategoryCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a globalisation message code, a default user message, and optional message arguments. It calls the superclass constructor with these parameters.
